plant and soil fungal assemblages are linked and respond to edaphic conditions along a successional gradient in a coastal dune system.

(1) plant and fungal communities respond similarly to soil properties along an edaphic and succession gradient, (2) soil pH acts as an important environmental driver of plant and fungal diversity, (3) plant and fungal diversity increase along the gradient, (4) plant functional diversity increases as well along the gradient, and (5) plant and fungal functional diversity are positively correlated.
